reasons.text: Arteta confirms Raya needs no surgery: Arsenal's keeper Arsenal keep Raya with seven clean sheets in 11 games Arsenal goalkeeper David Raya does not need surgery on the shoulder injury he suffered, Mikel Arteta has confirmed, and the problem is 'not too serious'.
Raya has kept seven clean sheets in 11 league games, and Arsenal have conceded only seven goals all season in the division.
Raya exited Saturday’s 2–2 draw with Newcastle United holding his arm after suffering an injury in what initially did not seem to be significant contact with Magpies striker William Osula.
Arsenal team news David Raya will miss out for Arsenal with a shoulder injury; Kepa Arrizabalaga will take his place.
Add in Arsenal without goalkeeper David Raya and Dortmund may have the opportunity to make life uncomfortable for the hosts.
Arsenal boss Mikel Arteta has revealed that David Raya won’t be fit to face Borussia Dortmund in the Champions League but his injury “doesn’t look too serious”.
The Arsenal boss also revealed that Raya would undergo an MRI scan on Sunday to assess the seriousness of the issue, and on the same day, he was photographed with his arm in a sling in London.
Raya played a key role as Arsenal ended a 22-year wait for a Premier League title last season and had started this campaign with seven clean sheets in 10 matches before the match in Newcastle.
Raya's injury came on the day Arsenal welcomed back William Saliba to the matchday squad.
Saka will not be available till mid-to-late December , while Zubimendi was ruled out for “a few weeks” just last Friday The third absentee, again as expected, was David Raya .
Raya will miss Tuesday’s clash with Borussia Dortmund but, encouragingly, Arteta said the Spaniard’s issue “doesn’t look too serious”.

reasons.text: Q: Is it too late to buy Maxim De Cuyper (£5.5m)? (via @vrw123 A: De Cuyper is firmly part of the current template, with just under 50% overall ownership, so you are always at risk of a rank drop if he hauls.

Then, if he later becomes a rotation risk, you can simply sell him when the fixtures toughen up, perhaps in Gameweek 18… But that might not even happen, with Kaoru Mitoma (£5.9m) perhaps not back for a while Another potential threat to De Cuyper’s place, Yankuba Minteh (£5.8m) also has an unclear fitness status, as per Neale’s early team news round-up De Cuyper is on three yellow cards.
Having provided an assist in the Red Devils’ victory over Turkey last Thursday, De Cuyper followed that up with a goal in Belgium’s riotous 4-1 win against Italy on Sunday.
It was De Cuyper’s goal that proved the catalyst for his side’s comeback.

De Cuyper’s not an issue for now, then, even if Luka Vuskovic (£5.2m) will likely end up being the long, long-term best pick at the back.

Raya.role: Raya played a key role as Arsenal ended a 22-year wait for a Premier League title last season and had started this campaign with seven clean sheets in 10 matches before the match in Newcastle.
